purpose: Teach: 異国/もとづい/予知/相反/強硬/残虐/妊婦/修道院

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、異国の生活様式を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You were working on foreign lifestyles for your paper, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm confirmation, genuinely interested. Opens with her name. Steady, observant pace. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and is checking in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、史料にもとづいた歴史検証を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined historical evidence and verified it through primary sources.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Slight lift of pride in the methodology. Not performing confidence, but owning the work clearly. Respectful without diffidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地震予知の科学を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You covered earthquake prediction science in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful beat before speaking. Genuinely curious about her angle. Warm but not leading. The pause of someone working through the complexity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、二つの理論が相反する点を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at where two competing theories contradicted each other.
lines.style: Steady and precise. A slight emphasis on 'contradicted' showing she chose that focus deliberately. Composed. No apology for the intellectual rigor.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 外交の強硬路線を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you took on diplomatic aggression as your topic?
lines.style: Alert, attentive confirmation. Slight lean forward in the voice. Acknowledging the weight of the subject without flinching. Professional but warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時の残虐行為を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined wartime atrocities and their context.
lines.style: Grave and clear. No flinching, but not clinical either. The voice of someone who's done serious work on difficult material. Brief, respectful of the subject's weight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 妊婦の心理研究を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You examined maternal psychology in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, checking in. Warm tone, genuine interest in where she took it. Steady rhythm. Not rushing past what could be sensitive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中世修道院の生活を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the daily life of medieval monks and nuns.
lines.style: Clear and present. Small closing warmth, a natural endpoint in her voice. Confident. The sense of having completed something meaningful.
